text.jp:
其方が救世主であったか。
お前たちの活躍、噂には聞いていた。
text.official_en: The Promised One. I've heard tell of your efforts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
危険の多い中、ここまで
足を運んでくれたこと、感謝する。
text.official_en:
I thank you for coming out here in the midst of so
many dangers...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここからは、妾も其方たちの助けとなれるよう、
陰ながら尽力させてもらうとしよう。
text.official_en: And I will do my utmost to assist you as I can.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえば救世主、妾は其方に
ひとつ頼みたいことがあったのだ。
text.official_en: Although...I also have a favor to ask.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
多くの者が未来に希望を持つことが出来ず、
不安にとらわれてしまっている。
text.official_en:
At this terrible time, many are overcome with dread
and unable to feel hope for the future.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……妾としても、そのような者達の心を
少しでも軽くしてやりたいのだが。
text.official_en: I would like to bring them a measure of ease.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
口惜しいが、このような状況では芸術や
音楽だけで皆の不安を取り除くことは難しい。
text.official_en:
As painful as it is to admit, in these times,
art and music alone can't help the people.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そこで、魔除けの護符を作って配ることを
考えたのだが、どうしても材料が足りぬのだ。
text.official_en:
So, I thought I'd make and send out amulets that
repel evil. But I simply don't have the materials.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
其方なら、遠方にも赴くであろう。
足労だが、その材料を集めてきてはくれぬか？
text.official_en:
If you happen to find them during your travels,
could I trouble you to bring them to me?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
無論、礼ならする。更なる上級の兵種に挑めるなど、
其方の力となるであろう、様々な褒美を用意しよう。
text.official_en:
I will compensate you, of course—I can grant you the
ability to take on a more advanced class.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
よい香木を見つけてきてくれたものだ。
これで護符を作ることができる。
text.official_en:
Ah yes, this fragrant wood should be perfect for
making the amulets.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このような物では、
気休め程度にしかならぬかもしれんが……
text.official_en:
I know this will only do so much to calm the
people's hearts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それでも……人々の心に
希望を与えることができるかもしれんからな。
text.official_en: But if it brings even a little hope, it's worth it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
しかし、流石は救世主。この状況下で
妾の望む物を探し当てるとは、見事よの！
text.official_en:
I never doubted you'd succeed, Promised One,
but I'm impressed you found it all in these times!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
約束の褒美だ。最上級の弓騎「ボウナイト」の
試験を、受けられるようにしてやろう。
text.official_en:
And as for the reward I promised. You can now take
the exam for the master archer class, <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:08>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そして妾の神殿の、神の道の門を
其方に開放しよう。存分に使うが良い。
text.official_en:
In addition, the Gate of the Gods at my temple will 
be open to you. Use it whenever you need.
text.real_en:
In addition, the Gate of the Divine Path at my temple will 
be open to you. Use it whenever you need.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それから……戦いはこれから厳しくなる。
其方、戦場で「アーク」を使いたくはないか？
text.official_en:
Lastly...the battles ahead will only grow more and
more difficult. Would you like an Arc?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
無論、只では渡せぬ。アークを使うには
我が神殿の試練に挑む必要があるのだ。
text.official_en:
I cannot give it to you for nothing, I'm afraid. You'd
have to take the test at my temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
さて、希望を求めるものは、今ダグシオンに
集まっていると聞いた。
text.official_en:
Now, many people have gathered in Dagsion,
seeking hope...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
妾も帝都に赴き、その者たちに護符を
授けに行くとしよう。では、さらばだ。
text.official_en:
I shall make my way to the capital and hand them
these amulets. Farewell.
